name: roslyn-mcp
description: Read-only C# code intelligence from the Roslyn compiler: symbols, references, implementations, callers, diagnostics and complexity.
long_description:
Roslyn MCP gives the model the C# compiler's semantic view of a codebase. Its ten `roslyn_*` tools are read-only: they search symbols, find references, implementations and callers, outline files, report compiler diagnostics without a build, and measure cyclomatic complexity. It is the companion to the .NET MCP Server (dotnet-mcp), which builds, tests and changes projects.

**Prerequisite: the .NET 10 SDK must be installed and `dotnet` must be on PATH.** A .NET runtime alone is not enough: the server loads your projects with the installed SDK's MSBuild, and the bundle runs `dotnet server/roslyn-mcp.dll`.

tools.name: roslyn_search_symbols
tools.description: Search for symbols declared in source using wildcard patterns (* and ?). Returns file paths and line numbers.

tools.name: roslyn_find_references
tools.description: Find all references to a symbol across the solution, with surrounding line text.

tools.name: roslyn_get_symbol_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a symbol: kind, signature, accessibility, attributes and declaration location.

tools.name: roslyn_find_implementations
tools.description: Find implementations of an interface or interface member, classes derived from a class, and overrides of virtual/abstract members.

tools.name: roslyn_find_callers
tools.description: Find the methods, properties and constructors that call a method or access a property/event (one level of the call hierarchy).

tools.name: roslyn_get_document_outline
tools.description: List the namespaces, types and members declared in a C# file with signatures and line ranges, so only the relevant lines need to be read.

tools.name: roslyn_get_diagnostics
tools.description: Get C# compiler errors and warnings from the in-memory workspace without running a build.

tools.name: roslyn_analyze_dependencies
tools.description: Report what Roslyn knows about the solution: per-project symbol counts (total/public/internal), project references as compiled, and the most used namespaces from using directives.

tools.name: roslyn_analyze_code_complexity
tools.description: Find methods whose cyclomatic complexity is at or above a threshold.

tools.name: roslyn_reload_workspace
tools.description: Discard the cached Roslyn workspace and load the solution again.
